intro: One pau ayam is about 240 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the bun, while the chicken filling gives you a bit of protein.
diet: Yes. Pau ayam is more balanced than sweet paus because of the protein from the chicken. One piece is good for a light breakfast or afternoon snack. If you want 2, count it as a full meal.
tips: Choose pau ayam over sweet paus for more protein.
One pau with unsweetened milk or kopi O kosong is enough for a light breakfast.
Tai pau is best shared between two people.

swap.name: 1 pau ayam + boiled egg
swap.why: Protein almost doubles, and calories stay moderate.

faq.q: Is the pau ayam at convenience stores halal?
faq.a: Some already have halal certification. Check for the halal logo on the packaging.

faq.q: Why is pau skin so white and fluffy?
faq.a: It uses specially processed flour and a yeast-risen dough before steaming.

faq.q: Can I keep pau ayam in the freezer?
faq.a: Yes. Steam it straight from frozen for 10 to 15 minutes.
